title: Transforming our world: the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development
overall_summary: Global plan of action for people, planet and prosperity, structured around 17 Sustainable Development Goals and 169 targets, with a strong emphasis on eradicating poverty, reducing inequalities, protecting the environment, and strengthening peace and partnerships.
core_principles: Eradication of poverty in all its forms as the greatest global challenge.
Integration and indivisibility of economic, social and environmental dimensions of sustainable development.
Universality of the agenda: it applies to all countries, developed and developing.
Leave no one behind and reach the furthest behind first.
Respect for human rights, gender equality and empowerment of women and girls.
Need for global partnership and solidarity, especially with the poorest and most vulnerable.

pillars.title: People
pillars.summary: Commitment to end poverty and hunger and ensure all people can fulfil their potential in dignity and equality, in a healthy environment.
focus_areas: Ending poverty and hunger in all forms.
Ensuring access to basic services such as health, education, water and sanitation.
Promoting dignity, equality and human development.

pillars.title: Planet
pillars.summary: Protection of the planet from degradation, including through sustainable consumption and production, sustainable management of natural resources and urgent action on climate change.
focus_areas: Sustainable management of land, water and oceans.
Tackling climate change and environmental degradation.

pillars.title: Prosperity
pillars.summary: Ensuring all people can enjoy prosperous and fulfilling lives and that economic, social and technological progress occurs in harmony with nature.
focus_areas: Productive employment and decent work for all.

pillars.title: Peace
pillars.summary: Fostering peaceful, just and inclusive societies that are free from fear and violence.
focus_areas: Building effective, accountable and inclusive institutions.

pillars.title: Partnership
pillars.summary: Mobilizing the means required to implement the Agenda through a revitalized Global Partnership for Sustainable Development.
focus_areas: Multi-stakeholder partnerships involving governments, private sector and civil society.

sections.title: Preamble
sections.summary: Introduces the Agenda as a plan of action for people, planet and prosperity, emphasizing the eradication of poverty as essential for sustainable development and framing the SDGs as integrated and universal.
key_points: Recognition that poverty in all forms and dimensions is the greatest global challenge.
Commitment to free humanity from poverty and heal the planet.
Introduction of the 17 SDGs and 169 targets as integrated and indivisible.
Emphasis on leaving no one behind and improving lives for all.

sections.title: Declaration
sections.summary: Sets out the vision, shared principles and commitments guiding the Agenda, including human rights, equality, and the integrated nature of development challenges.
key_points: Reaffirms commitments to the UN Charter, human rights treaties and major UN conferences.
Envisions a world free of poverty, hunger, disease, fear and violence with universal access to quality education, health care, water and energy.
Stresses respect for human rights, the rule of law, justice, equality and non-discrimination.
Highlights the importance of sustainable consumption and production and harmony with nature.
Recognizes the need for integrated solutions to interconnected challenges such as poverty, inequality, environmental degradation and peace.

sections.title: The new Agenda
sections.summary: Describes the universal, transformative and integrated nature of the Agenda, its relationship with previous development frameworks and the responsibilities of all countries.
key_points: Applies to all countries, taking into account national realities and capacities.
Builds on and aims to complete the unfinished business of the Millennium Development Goals.
Acknowledges different levels of development but stresses shared responsibility.
Highlights the importance of national ownership and implementation strategies.
Calls for addressing root causes of poverty and inequality, including structural issues in the global economy.

sections.title: Means of implementation
sections.summary: Explains how the Agenda will be implemented, including finance, technology, capacity-building, trade and systemic issues, in line with the Addis Ababa Action Agenda.
key_points: Stresses the importance of domestic resource mobilization, including fair and efficient tax systems.
Calls for increased international public finance, including official development assistance, particularly for least developed countries.
Encourages mobilization of private finance and sustainable investment.
Emphasizes technology transfer, innovation and capacity-building in developing countries.
Highlights trade as an engine for inclusive growth and the need for a universal, rules-based and equitable multilateral trading system.
Addresses systemic issues such as global economic governance, debt sustainability and policy coherence.

sections.title: Follow-up and review
sections.summary: Describes the monitoring and review architecture at national, regional and global levels to track progress and ensure accountability.
key_points: National governments are encouraged to conduct regular and inclusive reviews of progress, involving parliaments and stakeholders.
Regional platforms are expected to support peer learning and review.
The High-level Political Forum under the UN is designated as the central platform for global follow-up and review.
Reviews should be voluntary, country-led, evidence-based and focused on implementation and lessons learned.
Calls for improved data collection and capacity to measure progress, including disaggregated data to identify those left behind.

sdg_overview.headline: End poverty in all its forms everywhere.
main_themes: Eradicating extreme income poverty.
Reducing national poverty levels according to national definitions.
Social protection systems and resilience to economic, social and environmental shocks.

sdg_overview.headline: End hunger, achieve food security and improved nutrition and promote sustainable agriculture.
main_themes: Access to safe, nutritious and sufficient food all year round.
Ending all forms of malnutrition.
Sustainable and resilient agriculture that protects ecosystems and improves productivity.

sdg_overview.headline: Ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all at all ages.
main_themes: Reducing maternal and child mortality.
Combating communicable and non-communicable diseases.
Universal health coverage and access to essential health services and medicines.

sdg_overview.headline: Ensure inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning opportunities for all.
main_themes: Universal completion of quality primary and secondary education.
Equal access to affordable technical, vocational and tertiary education.
Relevant skills for employment, decent work and entrepreneurship.

sdg_overview.headline: Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls.
main_themes: Eliminating discrimination and violence against women and girls.
Ending harmful practices such as child, early and forced marriage.
Ensuring women’s full participation and equal opportunities for leadership.

sdg_overview.headline: Ensure availability and sustainable management of water and sanitation for all.
main_themes: Universal access to safe and affordable drinking water.
Adequate and equitable sanitation and hygiene for all.
Improved water quality, water-use efficiency and protection of water-related ecosystems.

sdg_overview.headline: Ensure access to affordable, reliable, sustainable and modern energy for all.
main_themes: Universal access to modern energy services.
Increasing the share of renewable energy in the global mix.
Improving energy efficiency.

sdg_overview.headline: Promote sustained, inclusive and sustainable economic growth, full and productive employment and decent work for all.
main_themes: Sustained per capita economic growth and higher productivity.
Full and productive employment and decent work for all.
Protection of labour rights and safe and secure working environments.

sdg_overview.headline: Build resilient infrastructure, promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization and foster innovation.
main_themes: Developing quality, reliable, sustainable and resilient infrastructure.
Promoting inclusive and sustainable industrialization.
Enhancing research, technological capabilities and innovation, especially for SMEs.

sdg_overview.headline: Reduce inequality within and among countries.
main_themes: Income growth for the bottom 40 per cent of the population.
Social, economic and political inclusion of all, regardless of status.
Eliminating discriminatory laws, policies and practices and promoting equal opportunities.

sdg_overview.headline: Make cities and human settlements inclusive, safe, resilient and sustainable.
main_themes: Access to adequate, safe and affordable housing and basic services.
Safe, affordable, accessible and sustainable transport systems.
Reducing environmental impact of cities and protecting cultural and natural heritage.

sdg_overview.headline: Ensure sustainable consumption and production patterns.
main_themes: Sustainable management and efficient use of natural resources.
Reducing waste generation through prevention, reduction, recycling and reuse.
Corporate adoption of sustainable practices and sustainability reporting.

sdg_overview.headline: Take urgent action to combat climate change and its impacts.
main_themes: Strengthening resilience and adaptive capacity to climate-related hazards.
Integrating climate change measures into policies and planning.
Improving education, awareness and institutional capacity on climate mitigation and adaptation.

sdg_overview.headline: Conserve and sustainably use the oceans, seas and marine resources for sustainable development.
main_themes: Reducing marine pollution of all kinds.
Sustainable management and protection of marine and coastal ecosystems.
Ending overfishing and illegal, unreported and unregulated fishing.

sdg_overview.headline: Protect, restore and promote sustainable use of terrestrial ecosystems, sustainably manage forests, combat desertification, and halt biodiversity loss.
main_themes: Conservation and restoration of terrestrial and freshwater ecosystems.
Sustainable forest management and halting deforestation.
Combating desertification, restoring degraded land and halting biodiversity loss.

sdg_overview.headline: Promote peaceful and inclusive societies for sustainable development, provide access to justice for all and build effective, accountable and inclusive institutions at all levels.
main_themes: Reducing all forms of violence and related deaths.
Rule of law and equal access to justice for all.
Reducing corruption and building effective, accountable and transparent institutions.

sdg_overview.headline: Strengthen the means of implementation and revitalize the global partnership for sustainable development.
main_themes: Mobilizing financial resources from multiple sources.
Enhancing technology, capacity-building and data for sustainable development.
Promoting multi-stakeholder partnerships at global, regional and national levels.
